name: 10469 · Bronx, NY
findings: ZIP 10469 (Bronx) has 195 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 47 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (49% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10469 (Bronx) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10469 (Bronx) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.text: 24 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 12 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 49 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
